body_text: Our structural design team works closely with our planners, architects and roads & infrastructure teams. We do this as part of our planning and design process in order to get vital engineering considerations integrated into our design early in the process. Why? Because structural design systems can greatly influence cost later in the design process. Our structural team can suggest options early and provide valuable feedback on options that may impact design and in many cases improve it. Using the latest industry software, our structural team works closely with local municipalities and has developed strong relationships with them. The relationships they have with Dubai Municipality have allowed many of our projects to obtain approvals quickly which in turn keep project schedules moving forward.
body_html:
Our structural design team works closely with our planners, architects and roads & infrastructure teams. We do this as part of our planning and design process in order to get vital engineering considerations integrated into our design early in the process.

Why? Because structural design systems can greatly influence cost later in the design process. Our structural team can suggest options early and provide valuable feedback on options that may impact design and in many cases improve it.

Using the latest industry software, our structural team works closely with local municipalities and has developed strong relationships with them. The relationships they have with Dubai Municipality have allowed many of our projects to obtain approvals quickly which in turn keep project schedules moving forward.
